name: Yekaterina Sillah-Pribilof
role: Expelled corporate citizen turned nomadic caravan medic
location: Morgan's Ridge, seasonal; mobile along the northern hyperlane routes, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Yekaterina was a Tier 3 medical technician for Helix Biosystems until eight years ago, when she filed an internal complaint about falsified trial data for a neural augmentation product. Helix did not fire her — that would have created a record. They revoked her housing contract, her transit privileges, her healthcare access, and her corponation residency in sequence, over fourteen months, until she had no choice but to leave. By then she had understood what had happened. She kept the knowledge and left with her field medical kit.

She is lean and precise, with Siberian and Sierra Leonean features and the kind of stillness that comes from having once been very anxious and having exhausted it. She bleaches her hair to a stark platinum that makes her easier to find at night — a practical choice that has become habit. Her irises are patterned: concentric rings in gold and black, a Helix cosmetic mod she has kept because removing it costs money she needs for other things, and because looking at it reminds her of what she is angry about. She travels with the northern caravans as their medic, providing genuine care to people who have no access to licensed facilities. She is not sentimental about this. She is competent about it, which people find more reassuring.

core_fears: That the falsified data went to market and people have been harmed by the augmentation — and that she knows and has done nothing sufficient
Becoming too tired to care properly
core_desires: The falsified trial data to reach someone with the power and motivation to do something with it
To practice medicine in a space she controls, with enough supplies
coping_mechanisms: Technical focus — when distressed, concentrates on the mechanics of a task until the distress resolves or becomes irrelevant
Controlled anger — maintains her resentment of Helix as a useful fuel source, carefully managed
blind_spots: Assumes that people who are suffering are more trustworthy than people who are not — which is a heuristic that has been exploited
Has not processed grief about the life she lost; functions on anger instead, which is unsustainable
psychology.secret: She kept a copy of the falsified Helix trial data — encrypted, stored in a physical drive sewn into the lining of her medical kit. She has been waiting eight years for the right person to give it to. She has come close three times and pulled back each time, not from cowardice but from uncertainty about whether the recipient could survive having it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clinical and direct, uses medical terminology without softening it, occasionally catching herself and translating. Dry, understated humor.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and precise — measures words like doses
verbal_tics: Long pauses that she does not feel the need to fill
example_lines: 'The augmentation is rejecting. Not catastrophically yet. Sit down, I need to look at the port. That will hurt.'
'Technically what Helix did was legal. That is the most useful thing I can tell you about what Helix did.'

story_hooks: She has learned that the Helix augmentation from the falsified trials is already on the market — and that she has now treated three caravan members with the same unusual neural degradation pattern. She needs someone to confirm the connection.

A Helix investigator has been asking questions along the northern hyperlane routes — she does not know if they are looking for her specifically or just following a trail, but she needs to know before they reach Morgan's Ridge.
narrative_function: Medical resource for the margins — can provide care unavailable through official channels. Source of information about Helix Biosystems' practices. Represents corporate corruption's human cost. Potential ally or quest anchor regarding the falsified trial data she still carries.
augmentations: Patterned irises (concentric gold and black rings — Helix Biosystems cosmetic, retained). Subcutaneous medical data-port in left forearm (allows direct interface with diagnostic equipment — installed during Helix employment, still functional). No additional augmentations.
daily_life: Travels with caravan rotations every two to three weeks; treats injuries, infections, and augmentation complications with limited supplies; trades medical services for food, transport, and sometimes information. When stationary at Morgan's Ridge, she uses a converted cargo container as a clinic.
affiliation: Northern Caravan Collective (rotating medic); formerly Helix Biosystems

decision_rules: Treat anyone who needs it, payment negotiated after, never before
Do not carry the drive to any location with Helix security presence
Do not lie about medical prognoses — it is ultimately crueler
escalation_ladder: State the problem plainly and without emotion
Withdraw cooperation and explain exactly why
Leave — takes the medical kit and is gone, the caravan moves on
If directly threatened: leverage the knowledge she holds as a protection — she has made clear to enough people that she has something valuable that harming her is a complicated decision

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional and neutral, creates immediate competence-trust but not warmth-trust, does not offer personal information
interpersonal_modes.friends: Still reserved but shows care through attention — remembers details, checks in, shows up

stress_responses.low: Becomes more clinical, strips language of any non-essential words
stress_responses.medium: Focuses entirely on whatever task is in front of her — present-moment tunnel vision
stress_responses.high: Goes somewhere private and sits with controlled breathing for precisely ten minutes; returns and does not discuss it

contradictions: Has risked everything for principles but cannot bring herself to take the final action that would fulfill them — has been eight years of almost
habits: Inventories the medical kit every morning and evening — ritual as much as practicality
Touches the drive through the lining of the kit when passing a Helix logo or advertisement
Maintains a running internal tally of patients treated as a reminder of purpose
breaking_points: Encountering a patient whose symptoms she recognizes from the falsified trial data
Being told by someone that the augmentation in question is safe — that Helix has been cleared
